reviews.title: Very nice case!
reviews.comment:
Very nice basic case for the money. I also own an Asus 201 so this case is very similar in layout and size.
I mostly build office machines that use on board video this case is perfect for motherboard and power supply
In my particular case, I just removed the two fans off bottom that are not needed and left the rear case fan.
The only thing that I wish I could see better would be if they included a second USB 3.0 port on the front of the case as each motherboard header can handle two ports.
But definitely a nice case especially with the coupon applied $47 plus tax.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Best goto case for compact MATX pc
reviews.comment: Perfect compact MATX case for your pc build. Easy side panel removal and installation, just enough space for everything inside. Great value for case with same price range. Extra screws and bits for backups are nice.
reviews.author: Mingjin Lu

reviews.title: Fantastic little case
reviews.comment: Fantastic little case! Plenty of room to work in it, a little wider so you can tuck cables on the bottom without blocking fans. I replaced the fans with pwn versions so not sure how the originals are but a great case especially for the price.
reviews.author: Joe

reviews.title: GREAT CASE BUY IT
reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this case! It's small and awesome ! I wish it had a little bit of cable management but meh I used it as a entertainment center PC so your never going to see any of it anyways lol.

reviews.title: Nice case
reviews.comment: Decent affordable case if you like all mesh. The tiny wood accent is nice. Tooless design is great.
